one_line: Make the claim in text, then prove it by packing item by item with hands only.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a girl from behind in a lilac backpack walks down an aircraft aisle past smiling crew and a man. No speech. Text: 'כן, באמת טסנו ל-10 ימים עם תיקי גב בלבד'.
q1_hook.why: A concrete, checkable claim in big text over a real plane scene gives a reason to stay (H1, H2). 'באמת' answers the viewer's doubt and opens a gap the packing shots close (H5). Sound is music, so the hook works only as text (H6); no voice or face addresses the viewer (H4).

beats.what: Girl from behind with a backpack in a plane aisle; 'כן, באמת טסנו ל-10 ימים'
beats.why: A claim over a real travel scene.

beats.what: Top-down open bag, hands load clothes then small items; '6 חולצות, 3 זוגות מכנסיים', 'אוזניות, דיאודורנט, מברשת'
beats.why: Counting what fits proves the claim, a new list every 2 s.

beats.what: Second, blue-grey bag; 'לקחנו דירה כי 11 לילות זה המון זמן', 'וקנינו בסופר שמפו'
beats.why: Answers the obvious doubt, what about washing and toiletries.

beats.what: More packing, headphones in a mesh pocket; 'ובדירה יש מכונת כביסה', 'כל תיק שקל 5 ק"ג'
beats.why: A number a parent can check against airline limits.

beats.what: Two children from behind with backpacks on a city street; 'חמשתנו טסנו רק עם תיק גב והיה נפלא'
beats.why: Real family use closes the argument.

beats.what: A pink backpack under an aircraft seat; 'וכמובן שזה נכנס מתחת למושב', 'לינק ומידע בתיאור'
beats.why: Last proof and the ask together.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: In the video only 'לינק ומידע בתיאור'. In the caption: 'כתבו ״תיקים״ ואשלח לכם את הלינקים' and 'עקבו אחרינו'. The packing list is also a save-worthy checklist, but no save is asked.
q2_flow.why: The hook's doubt ('really?') is answered step by step, with new text every 1 to 2 s over the same two overhead shots, so there is always something new to read (H5, R3). Parents save checklists like this (R7), and a travelling parent might send it (R5). It ends on the last proof (R1).

q3_cta.what: Video: 'לינק ומידע בתיאור' (0:17, text). Caption: 'רוצים לינק לתיקים שקנינו?', then '1. עקבו אחרינו' and '2. כתבו ״תיקים״ ואשלח לכם את הלינקים', plus three coupon codes and a search code.
q3_cta.why: The comment word is a legitimate keyword that delivers real links (C3). The video line points to the caption, so it is shown but not spoken (C6). It does not name the word, and the caption stacks follow, comment, coupons and a search code, against one CTA (C1).

q4_shown.what: A girl in a lilac backpack in the aisle at 0:00; top-down on an open bag, items placed 0:02 to 0:08; a blue-grey bag 0:09 to 0:15, stated weight 5 kg; two children with backpacks on a street 0:16; a bag under a seat 0:17.
q4_shown.why: The bag is handled from 0:02 and the real contents show the claim by volume (S1, S4). A family stating 'we flew' is a first-hand vouch (S6). The claim is checkable, with a weight, and no brand is pushed (K4, K5).

q5_edit.what: About 5 shots in 18 s (cuts near 2, 9, 16 and 17 s): two long static overhead shots with a text change every 1 to 2 s; no jump cuts or speed changes seen. Sung music. Ends on the under-seat shot.
q5_edit.why: The movement comes from items and text changing, not from cuts, which suits a demo (R3, E2). Text timed to each load lets a muted viewer follow (T1). At 18 s it fits one demo (R2), and it ends on the last proof (E8).

q6_topic.what: A family of five's 10-night trip with backpacks only: what fits and how. Serves parents planning family travel with fewer bags.
q6_topic.why: A real parent worry, 'can five of us manage with so little', answered with a list and a weight (K6, K4). It is useful and savable (R7), but it is a travel-gear Reel with no child moment or emotional peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone, static top-down shots of two open backpacks on a table, hands only; handheld shots from behind of a girl in a plane aisle and two children on a street; a close shot of a bag under a seat. Window light. Children only from behind.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands over an open bag is a no-face format and fills the frame so each item reads (S4, F5, F4). Children from behind keep faces off camera (S5). Plain, slightly grainy phone footage reads as homemade (H8, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: Bold white sans-serif text with a dark outline, centred, 1 to 2 lines, at about 65 to 75% of the frame height, a new line every 1 to 2 s: 'כן, באמת טסנו ל-10 ימים עם תיקי גב בלבד' (0:00), 'לקחנו 6 חולצות, 3 זוגות מכנסיים...' (0:02), 'כל תיק שקל 5 ק"ג' (0:15), 'לינק ומידע בתיאור' (0:17).
q8_text.caption: 'טסנו ל-10 לילות ורק לקחנו תיקי גב שקנינו ב-Aliexpress'. Very long, about 330 words: trip details, 'רוצים לינק?', two numbered asks, three coupon codes, a search code, five hashtags. No disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Big outlined text on a busy picture reads fast and works muted (T1, T2, T5), but it sits in the bottom band (T4, F2). The first caption line repeats the hook with searchable words, though the caption is very long and the hashtags generic (T7). Coupon codes carry no disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: The video says 'info in the description' while the caption asks for a comment word; four asks in the caption; a very long caption; no disclosure beside coupon codes; text in the bottom band.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the book hands-only from above, a new one-line card every 2 s, claim first, one comment word at the end. No face.
not_verified: Whose hands pack the bags; the bag brand (none visible); whether a song plays (transcript is garbled lyrics, so music is inferred); whether the coupon codes earn a commission. Correction: the second bag stays on screen to about 0:15, so there are about 5 shots, not 4; text sits at 65 to 75% of frame height. The girl's age (about 10) is an estimate.
